DEFECT: after accepting, the ACKNOWLEDGED trigger event stayed in active_plan.disruptions and was counted as open, so Today kept saying '1 项变化'/'通知 · 1 条活跃' (8 项变化 in a multi-event run) while Live said '当前没有需要你决定的调整。'. Live's handled notice was gated on disruptions.length===0, unreachable because acknowledgement is deliberately not resolution. Fixed by projecting event status/resolved_at and splitting open vs handled disruptions across Hub, the notification badge and Live; after the fix Today reads '已处理', the badge '无活跃', Live shows the handled notice with no banner, stable over 3 rounds.
